body:
Hilb Group, a portfolio company of The Carlyle Group, has acquired a full-service property and casualty and employee benefits agency based in Pennsylvania. The acquisition took effect on September 1, 2026, and expands Hilb Group’s presence in the Mid-Atlantic region.

Hilb Group helps businesses and individuals buy property and casualty insurance and employee benefits coverage, acting as broker and adviser. The Richmond, Virginia, firm grows by acquiring agencies and then using its resources to build their business organically. It has completed more than 200 acquisitions and operates more than 125 offices in 32 states. PEP reported Carlyle’s acquisition of Hilb Group from Abry Partners in October 2019.
